title: Boxed the compass on the strict q.t.
html_source: Changed identities on the quiet. Nautically, the expression “box the compass” means to know the 32 points and quarter-points of a compass, but idiomatically the phrase has come to mean “to achieve a complete reversal of stance or opinion”.
